audit: Priority/significance of an explicit integer matrix-weight point for hypothetical [[24,0,10]]_2 (AMH arXiv:2603.19901v1 Open Problem 1)
scope_guard: Positive answer concerns moment/SDP feasibility only (AMH Eq.31-35 + Eq.38). Not code existence. Correctness of the worker table is NOT assessed here.
summary: No earlier explicit integral matrix-weight table or genus-2 (biweight-type) enumerator for the hypothetical [[24,0,10]] was located in a bounded screen; the problem appears first in AMH v1 (2026-03-20, only version as of 2026-10-16). Underlying code existence is open (CRSS 1997/98 -> Rains-Sloane 1998 -> Danielsen-Parker 2006 -> codetables 2024-06-10 -> AMH 2026). The representation (stabilizer-state matrix weights = 5-type pair counts = symmetrized genus-2 enumerator) and its MacWilliams/Gleason machinery are classical, so a positive point is a computational feasibility answer, not code-existence progress. If verified: modest, short specialist answer to an explicit 7-month-old question whose content is a non-obstruction (AMH's integral Eq.31-35 relaxation cannot exclude [[24,0,10]]).

findings.claim: Underlying code open since CRSS
findings.quote: It is known [49] that there is no (24, 4^12) d = 10 classical code over GF(4), but the possibility of a (24, 2^24) d = 10 additive self-dual code remains open.
findings.date: arXiv v5 1997-09-10, p.26; Table III p.33 lists 8-10
findings.scope: code existence

findings.claim: Rains-Sloane restate open status; must be even
findings.quote: But the possibility of an additive trace-self-dual code of length 24 over F4 with minimal distance 10 remains open (see Table XIV). From Theorem 33, if such a code exists then it must be even.
findings.source: Rains & Sloane, Self-dual codes (Handbook of Coding Theory 1998)
findings.scope: code existence

findings.claim: Standard structural invariant: 5-designs in extremal additive F4 codes of length 6m
findings.quote: for an extremal additive code over F4 of length 6m, the supports with multiplicities of the codewords of any fixed weight form a 5-design with repeated blocks.
findings.scope: constrains but does not determine pair counts [INFERENCE]

findings.claim: Biweight/multiple weight enumerators with MacWilliams and Gleason generalizations are classical
findings.quote: The biweight enumerator of a code generalizes the weight enumerator to consider the overlaps of pairs of codewords ... Again there are generalizations of the MacWilliams and Gleason theorems
findings.scope: makes genus-2 constraint generation routine; not an earlier answer

theorem_comparison.AMH_OP1: Exists integral λ^{t,p}_{i,j} with x=λ/γ satisfying Eq.(31) (incl. all 169 Terwilliger PSD blocks for n=24), (32) pure, (33) self-dual, (34) x>=0 & λ∈Z, (35) Type II, with A_i of Eq.(38)?
theorem_comparison.worker_claim_if_verified: Explicit integral table satisfying all of the above (ALL_PASS), plus genus-2 MacWilliams self-duality, S3 symmetry and even-weight support (stronger than OP1 requires); worker reports an 8-dim affine genus-2 solution family (live evidence, unverified here).
theorem_comparison.already_known: Eq.(38) weights (CRSS 1998; OEIS A030331); λ^{0,0}_{i,0}=λ^{i,i}_{i,i}=A_i (AMH Eq.28); biweight/genus-2 MacWilliams and Gleason-type theory (MacWilliams-Mallows-Sloane 1972; Rains-Sloane 1998; NRS 2006 pointer); cubic quantum invariants (Rains 1997); 5-design property (Rains-Sloane).
theorem_comparison.delta: If verified, first located explicit point answering OP1 positively; equivalently, AMH's integral Eq.(31)-(35) relaxation cannot exclude [[24,0,10]].
theorem_comparison.not_delta: No construction or nonexistence of the code; no claim about MNH25 Thm 22 extra constraints, the full hierarchy (MNH25 Thm 7), genus>=3 constraints or realizability; no bound improvement.

significance_positive_characterization: If verified: a short specialist computational answer to an explicit, narrow 2026 question (7 months old), mainly informative as a non-obstruction for SDP-based exclusion of [[24,0,10]]. Not progress on the long-standing (1997) code-existence question.
major_definition_used: new method; settles a long-standing or prominent problem; quantitative SOTA gain under matched assumptions; physical consequence. None met.
counterpoints: Routine-ness [INFERENCE]: for K=1 stabilizer states Γ_ab=1 iff both Paulis are stabilizers, so λ is the 5-type pair-count (symmetrized genus-2) enumerator; classical genus-2 invariant theory plus integer search is standard specialist computation.
Scope: Remark 5 lists optional extra LP/SDP constraints; a reader may expect them inside OP1. A point checked only against Eq.(31)-(35) answers the literal statement.
Not over-dismiss: the SDP authors themselves posed it as open in 2026 and no earlier explicit point was located; an exact, checkable table definitively closes the literal question.
